lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Just transferred Folder E.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I appreciate your efforts.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: This is pretty serious stuff.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: They look like weapon development data.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: So you noticed.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I'm not a spy for nothing.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I know most things fairly well,

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: though I'm not an expert.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Even so, it won't make a difference.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I've already sent you everything you asked for.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: So, just what exactly do you want to do?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I told you, I'm going to be a goodwill ambassador.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: By now, you've got more than enough data.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Seems to me you're after something more.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You know what becomes of spies who think too much, don't you?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Then it would be best not to dwell on it.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'm far too occupied to entertain your little theories.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: All right, all right,

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: how long are you gonna keep this up?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I suppose it should be finished soon.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Well, make it quick.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Even I get a little freaked out every time we do this.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Wasn't "high risk, high reward" your motto?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Yes, but I don't see any return right now.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Rest assured,

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I always keep my promises.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: That sounds like something a villain would say.
